unit: EUR bn per year (ECB annual averages as trade_full.json); 2026 is not given: the pipeline sets 2026 = 2025 x 8/12 as now
replaces: research/2026-10/gaps/residual.json -> exports_to_rus_gap.countries (same shape: {ISO3: {year: {low, central, high}}}). Totals per year are unchanged (CIF/FOB, KGZ/KAZ transit and the residual total stay as in residual.json by_year); only the split of the residual component over countries changes.
method: Russia's customs (FCS) still publishes its imports by continent of origin (Europe, Asia, America, Africa, Oceania) although it stopped publishing by country. Russia records imports by country of ORIGIN, partners record exports by DESTINATION, so the gap per continent shows whose goods reach Russia without being declared as exports to Russia. Steps: (1) partner-reported exports to Russia (trade_full.json, central) summed by UN M49 continent; (2) hub re-exports (reexports.json x refine.json shares, belarus.json) moved from the hub's continent to the origin continents (origin_shares); (3) gap per block = FCS imports - origin-adjusted partner exports, blocks Asia, West (Europe + Americas, combined because EU-reported exports carry US-origin goods: in 2021 Europe's partner exports exceeded FCS imports from Europe by 5% while the Americas' fell 52% short), Africa+Oceania; (4) minus CIF/FOB (residual.json share 3.5-7.5% of FCS, Asia's rate 0-30% higher for sea freight) and minus the KGZ/KAZ unrecorded transit by origin block (residual.json origin_shares_of_hub_increase; OTHER split 30-70% Asia); (5) the rest, floored at 0, gives each block's share of residual.json's residual component (20,000 Monte Carlo draws: FCS +-1% (2022 +-2%), Belarus +-12%, partner sums +-2%, re-export moves x0.5-1.5, CIF/FOB, transit). Within blocks: Asia pro rata to reported exports with coalition weight 0.25 (as residual.json); West by Russia's own 2021 imports by origin (Comtrade reporter 643, 2021, excluding BLR and UKR), i.e. the pre-war origin mix the parallel imports replace; Africa+Oceania pro rata to reported exports. Belarus keeps its old value (its share is re-spread by the pipeline as now). Transit (KGZ/KAZ) parts per country are kept from residual.json (old value minus its reconstructed pro-rata part).
pre_war_check: 2021 origin-adjusted ratios partner/FCS: Asia 0.913, Europe 1.054, Americas 0.48, Africa 0.50. After CIF/FOB the 2021 residual is entirely Asian (+ small Africa/Oceania), i.e. the old pro-rata rule fits the pre-war pattern. The war years differ: Europe's ratio fell to 0.92 (2023) and 0.91 (2024); Asia's stayed near 0.87-0.89 until 2024, then fell to 0.81 in 2025.
